messages:
karen_docs: Hey team — I've dropped an initial changelog entry for the regional routing update into `releases/routing-tweaks` branch. Goal: short user-facing blurb + migration note + 3 cross-SDK snippets. PTAL before I hand to localization.

priya_pm: Can we keep the blurb super short (1–2 lines) and push the details to a 'Migration notes' section? Also add a Known Issues bullet about transient embedding mismatches after failover.

karen_docs: Yep — draft structure is Blurb / Migration notes / Known issues / SDK examples. Link: https://staging.redwood/docs/releases/routing-tweaks-preview

matt_sre: Heads up: the internal failover window is 45s (not 30s) for this rollout. Please update any user-facing text that mentions the duration.

karen_docs: Updated to 45s. Thanks.

jonathan_sdk: SDK FYI: JS and Python examples should use `client.completions.create` and `client.completions.stream` patterns respectively. Our Go SDK recently renamed `Stream` -> `Completions.Stream`. I'll provide corrected snippets.

karen_docs: Great — please paste them here so I can copy into the draft.

jonathan_sdk: JS (sync):
```
const out = await client.completions.create({ model: "redwood/kitefish-2000", input: "Summarize the rollout..." });
console.log(out.output_text);
```
JS (stream):
```
const stream = await client.completions.stream({ model: "redwood/kitefish-2000", input: "Token by token..." });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```
Python (stream):
```
with client.completions.stream(model="redwood/kitefish-2000", input="...") as s:
  for event in s:
    print(event.delta, end="")
```
Go (stream):
```
stream, _ := client.Completions.Stream(ctx, "redwood/kitefish-2000", opts)
for stream.Next() {
  fmt.Print(stream.Value().Text)
}
```

jonathan_sdk: Note: ensure examples use `input` not `prompt` (we migrated names last quarter).

karen_docs: Replaced `prompt` -> `input` across the doc. Also flagged headings with `{{i18n}}` for l10n team.

matt_sre: Link check: `/docs/regions/apac` still exists in staff notes. That path redirects and will fail our docs linter. Use `/docs/regions/ap-southeast` canonical.

link-bot: link-scan: /docs/regions/apac => 302 -> /docs/regions/ap-southeast (recommend update). /docs/dedicated/configuration#pinning => 200 OK. /docs/releases/routing-tweaks-preview => 200.

karen_docs: Swapped APAC links to canonical `/docs/regions/ap-southeast`. Thx bot.

priya_pm: Migration note suggestion: "If you depend on `region=apac` env var, switch to `ap-southeast` before 2024-10-01. Otherwise routing may temporarily route to a fallback region during the transition." Keep that callout short.

matt_sre: Add a short mitigation: "Use pinning (`region`) in Dedicated config to avoid cross-region failover during rollout." Also call out that reindexing embeddings is usually automatic within 2–5 minutes.

karen_docs: Added both lines to Migration notes and Known Issues. Also added a small user-facing example for pinning in the Dedicated section.

jonathan_sdk: One tiny nit: the JS snippet in the preview prints `out.output_text` but most SDKs also support `out.output[0].content` — either is OK but pick one consistently.

karen_docs: Switched all examples to `output_text` for brevity.

priya_pm: Final request: please keep the changelog header `unrelease: true` until the embargo. We'll flip it at publish.

karen_docs: Done — front-matter set to `unrelease: true`. PR #5341 open with all edits and staging preview.

matt_sre: Quick check done. Left a small wording nit. LGTM after that.

jonathan_sdk: :eyes: on PR.

priya_pm: :shipit: once the nit is addressed. I'll schedule the announcement in product channel on publish.

karen_docs: Thanks all — closing thread. Please leave reactions on PR #5341 so I know when to unfreeze.
